properties.note: Lowest verified minimum of the HNCO...H2O pre-reaction complex (N-H...O_w hydrogen bond, C_s). Barrier reference for the water-addition step.

Second conformer/minimum of the same HNCO...H2O complex (loose O-bridge of water: N...O_w 2.94, C...O_w 3.02 A) and the minimum reached by the reactant branch of the TS1 IRC; 5.78 kcal/mol above RC. The RC -> RC2 reorientation is barrierless (relaxed C...O_w scan of work/ts/rot_scan_cow.log is monotonic with no maximum), so it is a conformational connection of one reactant-complex state, not an elementary step with its own saddle.

1 imaginary frequency -1579.3 cm-1; the imaginary mode is dominated by the water proton (H6) shuttle between the water O and the isocyanate N (H6 weight ~96%, C2-O4 projection only ~0.10), so the saddle is a proton-transfer saddle and the C-O contraction develops along the IRC path.
Carbamic acid, syn/Z conformer (O=C-O-H = 0 deg, planar); the TS1 IRC target and the lowest carbamic-acid minimum. Reference for the decomposition barrier.
1 imaginary frequency -465.6 cm-1, O=C-O-H torsion (syn -> anti) coupled to the NH2 twist.
Carbamic acid, anti/E conformer (O=C-O-H = 165.7 deg, NH2 twisted); +7.97 kcal/mol above CA1.

1 imaginary frequency -1656.7 cm-1; the imaginary mode is 97.7% H7 (O4-H7 -> N1-H7 proton transfer) with C2-N1 lengthening (1.601 A at the saddle). 4-membered ring O4-H7-N1-C2. The verified IRC (ts/ts_0002/jobs/declaration_0006/irc/irc.log) connects CA2 (anti carbamic acid) to the loose NH3...CO2 pair; barrier referenced to the lowest carbamic-acid minimum CA1 is 43.13 kcal/mol (35.16 kcal/mol if referenced to the IRC-true source conformer CA2).

NH3...CO2 post-reaction complex at its LOWEST verified minimum (N...C 2.756 A, linear CO2, three N-H ~1.02 A, lowest real mode 7.4 cm-1, 0 imaginary frequencies) - the minimum actually reached by the product branch of the decomposition IRC (frame-started Opt from the canonical outer frame). Binding this log makes the product reference the lowest verified minimum, as the rules require: CA1 -> PC = 43.13 kcal/mol and RC -> PC = -17.9 kcal/mol are then computable from the graph's own node energies. A second, tighter conformer of the same N.O=C=O species (N...C 3.115 A, H-bonded contact) lies 2.23 kcal/mol HIGHER and is documented only as a conformer: work/min/pc2_opt_freq.log, E = -244.960519635 Ha, 0 imaginary frequencies.

edges.channel: Net-step / barrier-reference edge for water addition to HNCO: barrier 36.78 kcal/mol = E(TS1) - E(RC) with the lowest verified reactant-complex minimum RC as reference (per the rules). The direction-verified elementary step of this channel is RC2 -> CA1 (edge e1b): the TS1 IRC reactant-side valley ends at the RC2 conformer, and RC -> RC2 is a barrierless reorientation (monotonic relaxed C...O_w scan, work/ts/rot_scan_cow.log), so no IRC started at TS1 can ever produce an outer frame on the RC side. A first-order saddle has only two downhill valleys.

Same elementary step at the IRC-true source minimum: the forward IRC branch from TS1 reaches the RC2 conformer, so E(TS1) - E(RC2) = -244.876786271 + 244.926200315 = 0.049414044 Ha = 31.01 kcal/mol (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0002/frequency/frequency.log and work/ts/ep1_src_rc2_opt_freq.log). Consistent with the net-step value: RC2 lies 5.78 kcal/mol above RC, so 36.78 - 5.78 = 31.00. An earlier 42.56 kcal/mol on this edge was an arithmetic slip and is corrected here.
Carbamic acid conformer interconversion (O=C-O-H torsion syn -> anti); barrier referenced to its own initial conformer CA1.

Net-step / barrier-reference edge for carbamic-acid decomposition: barrier 43.13 kcal/mol = E(TS2) - E(CA1) with the lowest verified carbamic-acid minimum CA1 as reference (per the rules); rate-determining step. The direction-verified elementary step is CA2 -> PC (edge e3b): the TS2 IRC source valley ends at the CA2 (anti) conformer, so no IRC started at TS2 can produce an outer frame on the CA1 side.
Same elementary step at the IRC-true source minimum: the decomposition IRC reaches the CA2 (anti) conformer, so E(TS2) - E(CA2) = 35.16 kcal/mol.
